chunks: Isma'il ibn Mihran, from Durust, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the diyah of the Jews, the Christians, and the Magians.
He said: “They are equal: eight hundred dirhams.”
He said: So I said: May I be made your ransom, if they are apprehended in the lands of the Muslims while committing an indecent act, is the hadd carried out upon them?
He said: “Yes, judgment is carried out concerning them according to the rulings of the Muslims.”

key_terms.بِأَحْكَامِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: according to the legal rulings of the Muslims
key_terms.ثَمَانُمِائَةُ دِرْهَمٍ: the amount of eight hundred dirhams
key_terms.دِيَةِ: blood-money compensation for unlawful killing or injury

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah of Jews, Christians, and Magians, and are hadd penalties applied to them in Muslim lands?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the diyah of Jews, Christians, and Magians, stating that they are equal at eight hundred dirhams. It also states that when such persons are apprehended in Muslim lands committing a punishable indecency, they are judged according to the legal rulings applied among Muslims.
